svg.title: Services — Mobile apps and Backend APIs
svg.desc: Services. Mobile apps (2–6 weeks): Flutter for iOS & Android, Multi-role auth · Firebase, Razorpay / Stripe payments, CI/CD · App Store + Play release. Backend APIs (1–3 weeks): .NET Web API or Node.js, Auth · security alerting, Supabase or Firebase, Fully documented. Open to freelance. Start a project: bhanushaliharsh434@gmail.com.
